title: Universal Life Insurance Claims Manual: Death Claims and Proceeds
content:
## 1. Coverage

A death claim on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is covered when, on the date of death, the policy was in force, in the grace period or overloan protected.

## 2. Proof and approval

Death proceeds are disbursed only on a death claim whose certified death certificate has been received and whose request status is approved. Disbursement proceeds only while the policy status is death claim pending or claim paid. Both facts are read from the company's records: the certificate and approval from the death claim on the service record, the status from the policy record.

## 3. Contestable review and suicide exclusion

A death within the tier's contestable period of the issue date or reinstatement date is approved only after contestable review. Death by suicide within the tier's suicide exclusion period of the issue date pays only the premiums paid less withdrawals.

## 4. Amount of the proceeds

Otherwise the death benefit on the date of death is:

| Death benefit option | Death benefit |
|---|---|
| Option A | The greater of the face amount and the account value times the corridor factor for the insured's attained age |
| Option B | The greater of the face amount plus the account value, and the account value times the corridor factor |

The proceeds are the death benefit, less the loan balance and the loan interest accrued to the date of death, less monthly deductions unpaid during a grace period. Interest is added to each payee's share at the tier's death claim interest rate, simple, for the actual calendar days from death to disbursement over 365, rounded to the cent.

## 5. Payees

Proceeds are divided among the surviving primary beneficiaries of the designation in effect at death, by share. A predeceased primary's share passes pro rata to the surviving primaries, then to the contingents, then to the owner or the owner's estate. A minor's share, below the tier's minor beneficiary age, is paid only to a court-appointed guardian or UTMA custodian. A payee with a share of at least the tier's Beneficiary Access Account minimum may elect an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

*Option A.* Face $250000.00, account value $180000.00, insured aged 72 (corridor factor 1.15): 1.15 times $180000.00 is $207000.00, below the face, so the death benefit is $250000.00. With a loan balance of $20000.00 and $400.00 of accrued loan interest, the proceeds are $229600.00.

*Option B.* Face $250000.00, account value $180000.00, same age: the face plus the account value is $430000.00, above $207000.00, so the death benefit is $430000.00.

*Predeceased primary.* Primaries A 50%, B 30%, C 20%; C predeceased. C's 20% passes pro rata to A and B in the ratio 50 to 30: A receives 62.5% and B 37.5% of the proceeds.
